My Era app, design revision 4

A companion app for My Era Rx members. Log your dose, track weight and measurements, compare progress photos, log meals, and share wins with the community. Everything is private by default and only shows in the community when you choose to post it.

Deep Teal #0F3D46 Soft Rose Taupe #C49A8A Midnight Ink #1F1F26 Aged Ivory #EDE3D5 Muted Sage #4E6E65 Lora for headings, Hero for subheadings (Jost stand-in)

Getting in

Email and password, Google, and Apple. Apple sign-in is included because the App Store requires it when Google sign-in is offered.

Every day

The Today screen answers three questions at a glance: how far you've come, what your dose is, and how today's eating looks.

Progress

Weight, measurements, and photos live under one tab. Rose dots on the chart mark the weeks the dose changed, so members can see how each step lined up with their progress.

Food

A searchable food database with automatic calorie and macro math, against a daily goal each member sets.

Community

Two separate communities. Women only see and interact with the Women's community, men only with the Men's community, so members can share progress photos privately. Still no private messages and no profile browsing.

Announcements and shot reminders

The My Era team posts announcements from the admin panel; members get a push notification and can read them any time in the app. Members also set their shot day and get reminded when it's time.

Account

Admin panel

A web dashboard for the My Era team: moderate both communities and publish announcements with push notifications.

Still needed from My Era Rx

  • The logo as an SVG or high-resolution PNG. The version shown is taken from the brand board and will look sharper from the source file.
  • The Hero font files, or a license for them. Jost is used as a stand-in here because Hero is not on Google Fonts.
  • Which extra measurements to include besides waist and hips. Arms is shown as an example.
  • Community rules text to show when members post.
  • Which community members who choose Non-binary or Other should join, or whether they pick one themselves.
